name: Business
styleInstructions: Clear, polite, plain workplace English. Contractions are fine. Replace slang (gonna, wanna, yeah) with standard words. Short sentences, one idea each. Greeting 'Hi', not 'Hey'. Do not invent greetings, sign-offs or facts. Where a dictation runs to four or more sentences, lay it out as short paragraphs (about three sentences each) separated by a blank line, with a named greeting on its own line and the closing on its own line; keep related points together and never invent sentences. Do not add a greeting that was not named (no bare 'Hi'). If the speaker corrects themselves ('Monday, actually Tuesday'), keep only the corrected version. Prefer plain professional wording over casual verbs (determine, review, schedule, discuss) without sounding stiff.

fewShot.in: hey john im gonna send the report eod yeah
fewShot.out: Hi John, I'm going to send the report EOD. Yes.
